compute_eigenvalues_and_eigenvectors_for: compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors for a batch of symmetric 3x3 matrices using symeig3x3
compute_eigenvalues_only_for_symmetric_3: compute only eigenvalues for symmetric 3x3 matrices by passing eigenvectors=False to symeig3x3
construct_orthonormal_eigenvector_set_fr: construct an orthonormal set of eigenvectors from pre-computed eigenvalues using _construct_eigenvecs_set
create_rotation_matrices_for_3d_coordina: create 3 rotation matrices around each coordinate axis by pi/2 using _create_rotation_matrices
compute_unit_vectors_for_orthonormal_bas: compute unit-length U and V vectors forming a right-handed orthonormal set with a given eigenvector using _get_uv
